comment: Independent re-check run 22 Oct 2026 with the engine's own deterministic checks (grounding.unsupported_terms / ungrounded_numbers) on the 37 PubMed-based items in the reports of 7, 14, 21 and 26 September 2026, and openFDA for the one FDA item.
